description: This file defines a Cache class responsible for managing a file-based cache system, including storing, retrieving, and clearing cached data, with internal directory management.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A class that provides static methods to handle caching of data using filesystem operations, including storing, retrieving, and deleting cache items.

methods.name: getDirectory
methods.description: Returns the cache directory path, creating a temp subdirectory if not already printed.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the cache, creating necessary directories.

methods.name: ensureCacheDirectoryExists
methods.description: Creates the cache directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: forget
methods.description: Removes a cache item by key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by key if it exists.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Generates the filesystem path for a cache key using SHA1 hash partitioning.

methods.name: rrmdir
methods.description: Recursively removes a directory and its contents.
